title: Enjoyment of driving and ownership
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly describe owners genuinely enjoying the G60, especially its driving experience, ride, technology, and overall ownership feel.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car is enjoyable to drive and own, with praise for the ride, technology, gadgets, and overall experience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention sporty feel and an energy boost feature as exciting, but there is not enough context to classify the overall sentiment confidently.

limitations: The sampled fragments are short and heavily centered on general enjoyment statements, so detail on specific underlying attributes is limited.
One positive fragment includes wording about battling the computer system while also referencing enjoying the drive, which reduces clarity in the sampled evidence for this topic.
Samples are sentiment-stratified and not representative estimates of all G60 reviews.
